title: Cosmic Recurrence Framework: Dynamics, Predictive Equivalence, Observer Indistinguishability, Cosmic Coordinates, and Fate-Conditioned Cosmology
description: A reproducible master research repository for exact and near recurrence, predictive quotients, observer-relative indistinguishability, recurrence-period and phase constraints in finite dynamics, a model-conditional cosmic coordinate, and fate-conditioned cosmological recurrence. Finite benchmark results are explicitly separated from cosmological inference; the repository does not claim that the physical universe is known to recur or that a cosmic recurrence period is currently identified.
